title: SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Contract for skill frontmatter validated by compile-harness.sh before render (SDD-008). Required fields are the universal subset present in every skill (Claude Code convention: name + description); vault skills additionally carry id/type/status/allowed-tools. Lives in the repo (not the vault) so validation runs offline, consistent with ENGINE-001's committed source-of-record.

name.description: Skill identifier; also the deployed directory/command name.

targets.description: Optional per-skill agent allowlist (e.g. [claude, opencode]); absent = all agents.
